QuestInfo.name: Reunion with Aran
QuestInfo.0: You greet Aran happily, but Aran doesn't seem to recognize you. Continue your conversation to find out what happened.
QuestInfo.1: Aran lost her memory due to the Curse. You can't help but feel disappointed.
QuestInfo.2: You finally met Aran, but her memory was gone. You both promised to meet again once Aran's memory returns.

0.msg: Sorry, I don't recognize you. I'll come find you once my memory returns.

1.msg: Okay. I'll be waiting for you. You and Mercedes made a lot of food... I mean, it wasn't all that great but if we can do that again, I'll... I'll eat it. Just use less sugar next time.

2.msg: I cooked for you? Lilin told me I have no taste. But I'll give it a try. Gotta do something when the heroing business is done.

3.msg: I imagine your journey here wasn't easy. I'll send you back to the #rSix Path Crossway#k.\r\n#r(You will be moved to the map immediately. Press ESC if you do not wish to move.)#k\r\n
